state.evaluationScope: Final independent implementation-checkpoint review for Plan45 Phase1, after addressing the earlier hook-smoke coverage findings.
state.background: This is a new review; an earlier direct SystemOne review returned valid_as_defined before discovering smoke-coverage gaps and temporary probe artifacts. That earlier verdict is superseded and must not drive this decision. Probe artifacts have now been cleaned up. User explicitly clarified local pre-push is sufficient; do not impose GitHub Actions/CI changes. The user also requires later detailed Phase5 investigation of all 33 current MAP-ineligible IDs; those classifications are provisional and must not be treated as conclusive exclusions.
implementationEvidence: vitest.browser.config.ts: separate Vitest 4 Browser Mode config via @vitest/browser-playwright 4.1.11; Chromium headless viewport 1280x800, tests/browser-mode/**/*.browser.test.tsx, E2E exclusion, retained failure trace/screenshots.
package.json scripts: test:browser uses that config; test:full is lint:fast -> type-check -> test:all -> test:browser -> build -> test:build-parity -> security-check -> test:e2e:clean -> test:e2e.
vitest.config.ts: default environment happy-dom; excludes tests/browser-mode/**. Thus pnpm test and pnpm test:browser are explicitly separated.

ThemeToggle.browser.test.tsx renders the real client component in Chromium and checks real browser click transitions, localStorage/document theme state, text and accessible labels. ThemeToggle-style.browser.test.tsx checks actual Chromium computed CSS and getBoundingClientRect 44px minimum touch bounds.

.husky/pre-push.bash: changed profile runs changed integration tests then test:browser; empty/invalid/indeterminate or failed related selection falls back to full profile; full profile includes test:browser in sequence; hook_gate || return/exit stops on failure. Docs/assets-only path skips integration and Browser Mode; build and E2E still run as baseline changed profile gates.

scripts/hook-smoke.mjs final coverage: docs/assets-only skip asserts no related/test:all/test:browser invocation; invalid JSON, empty set, and indeterminate Vitest JSON each exercise changed-profile full fallback and assert test:browser exactly once; full and changed Browser Mode failures each reject fixture push, preserve remote main ref, and prove later gates are skipped; also verifies full gate ordering and multiple ref/deletion/failure atomicity cases.

Final reported verification: Browser Mode 2/2 pass (latest CI=1 run with XDG cache temp and PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH pointing at existing local browser due sandbox cache redirection); pnpm suite 84 files, 772 pass, 4 skipped; pnpm run test:hook-smoke passes all cases; lint, type-check, bash -n, node --check, diff-check pass.

Boundaries: one-time manual Chromium installation is a prerequisite; no actual external push was performed; no Next production route, SSR, Flight, hydration, or full app shell is claimed/tested. No GitHub Actions changes are required by user.
acceptanceCriteria: A separate real Chromium Browser Mode setup and actual client component/browser DOM specs exist and run independently from happy-dom tests.
Default pnpm test remains the happy-dom suite and does not absorb Browser Mode specs.

The agreed required enforcement is local pre-push. Changed/full routing invokes Browser Mode at the right point; docs/assets-only skips code tests; empty/invalid/indeterminate related selection invokes full fallback including test:browser exactly once; failures stop execution and reject fixture pushes without changing refs or running later gates.
test:full keeps Browser Mode in its stated complete local validation sequence.
Phase1 acceptance does not imply external-push or Next production runtime verification. Phase5 must individually investigate all 33 current MAP-ineligible IDs and preserve their provisional status.
state.priorReview: Superseded historical API review stored at results/plan45/phase1/jev-api-phase1-implementation-checkpoint-request.json and ...response.json. Its valid_as_defined decision preceded newly found hook-smoke gaps and is not current evidence.
state.outputRequirement: Answer each keyed choice. Choose valid_as_defined only if final supplied code/results support all Phase1 criteria and no material defect remains. The affected-location/evidence/action/uncertainty keys should provide structured finding details. For an identified issue, select its exact location and concrete next action.

phase1_verdict.instructions: Does this final Phase1 checkpoint meet the stated acceptance criteria?

criteria.valid_as_defined: Phase1 is ready as implemented within the local/pre-push boundary: separate real-browser Browser Mode config and specs, happy-dom suite separation, changed/full pre-push routing, fail-stop behavior, and smoke coverage all meet the stated Phase1 objective.
criteria.implementation_change_needed: A specific implementation defect blocks Phase1. Select this only if identified by the supplied final code/evidence.
criteria.plan_or_spec_change_needed: Implementation is sound but the Phase1 requirement text in Plan45/OpenSpec contradicts the explicitly agreed local pre-push scope. Identify exact conflict.
criteria.evidence_gap_requires_hold: No concrete implementation or requirement defect is established, but a specific required proof is missing before Phase1 can be accepted.

finding.instructions: What concrete primary finding is supported by the final implementation and test evidence?

criteria.no_material_issue: No material Phase1 defect; supplied evidence supports the stated local/pre-push acceptance boundary.
criteria.browser_mode_setup: Specific defect in vitest.browser.config.ts, @vitest/browser-playwright integration, or test:browser script.
criteria.happy_dom_separation: Specific defect in default pnpm test and browser test isolation/routing.
criteria.changed_full_routing: Specific defect in .husky/pre-push.bash or impact classifier: changed/full dispatch or conservative fallback is incorrect.
criteria.browser_fail_stop: Browser Mode failure does not block push, later gates still run, or fixture remote ref changes after failure.
criteria.hook_smoke_coverage: scripts/hook-smoke.mjs does not correctly cover one of the requested skip/fallback/failure cases.
criteria.test_full_order: test:full script omits or misorders an agreed gate.
criteria.plan_spec_conflict: Specific Plan45/OpenSpec requirement contradicts implementation or the user-confirmed scope.
criteria.evidence_gap: A specific acceptance claim lacks evidence.
criteria.other_concrete_issue: Other concrete issue directly shown by supplied evidence.

affected_location_or_requirement.instructions: Which exact source paths or acceptance requirement are affected by that finding?

criteria.browser_config_and_tests: vitest.browser.config.ts; tests/browser-mode/ThemeToggle.browser.test.tsx and ThemeToggle-style.browser.test.tsx; Phase1 Browser Mode setup requirement.
criteria.default_test_config: vitest.config.ts and package.json pnpm test/test:browser scripts; suite separation requirement.
criteria.hook_smoke: scripts/hook-smoke.mjs; skip, fallback invocation-count, and fail-stop proof requirement.
criteria.full_script: package.json test:full script; full validation sequence requirement.
criteria.evidence_only: No implementation path is implicated; a particular evidence item is missing.
criteria.other: Other exact location/requirement evident in the input.

evidence_assessment.instructions: What does the supplied final verification establish?

criteria.evidence_supports_acceptance: Final implementation plus reported local verification cover all listed Phase1 checks; limitations are explicit and outside the local/pre-push claim.
criteria.specific_failed_or_missing_case: One requested case demonstrably fails or is absent; use only if the evidence names it.
criteria.reported_results_not_verifiable: Required result is only asserted but insufficiently tied to an observed test/check output.
criteria.scope_conflict: Supplied requirement contradicts user-confirmed local pre-push scope.
criteria.insufficient_to_decide: Evidence does not distinguish acceptance from a specific blocker.

proposed_next_action.instructions: What is the immediate next action? If valid, accept Phase1 and preserve the mandatory later per-ID Phase5 eligibility investigation.

criteria.accept_phase1_and_continue: Accept this final Phase1 checkpoint and continue the plan. Record that Phase5 must investigate each of the 33 current MAP-ineligible IDs individually; do not treat those classifications as final exclusions.
criteria.change_code_only: Modify implementation only to address the concrete defect; leave Plan45/OpenSpec text unchanged.
criteria.revise_plan_spec_only: Change Plan45/OpenSpec text only to resolve the concrete requirement mismatch; leave implementation unchanged.
criteria.collect_evidence_only: Collect only the exact missing evidence; do not change code or requirement text.
criteria.hold_for_scope_decision: Hold for a decision because evidence shows a genuine conflict in the agreed scope.

remaining_uncertainty.instructions: What uncertainty remains for the bounded local/pre-push Phase1 acceptance?

criteria.none_for_defined_local_gate: No blocking uncertainty remains for local Phase1/pre-push acceptance; the external push and production app boundaries are explicitly excluded.
criteria.chromium_manual_precondition: Whether one-time manual Chromium installation is a usable prerequisite remains open.
criteria.actual_push_unverified: An external push was not performed, leaving remote-side hook invocation unverified.
criteria.production_runtime_unverified: Next production route, SSR, Flight, hydration or full app shell was not tested; determine if relevant to the Phase1 local-gate claim.
criteria.some_reported_checks_missing: One or more listed local checks/results are absent or incomplete.
criteria.other_specific_uncertainty: Another concrete unresolved item is present in the evidence.
